policy: Queue membership means outcome-side evidence is promising enough for targeted enrichment. It does not imply scored-gold eligibility, predicted direction, or evaluation success.

missing_for_scored_gold: quantitative freight-rate or shipping-cost series with dated provenance
candidates.next_evidence_target: Add a dated quantitative shipping-cost/freight-rate outcome series and a contemporaneous pre-outcome hypothesis source without using later hindsight.

missing_for_scored_gold: multi-date shipment/throughput outcome series rather than a single first-shipment observation
candidates.next_evidence_target: Extend the first-shipment observation into a sourced time series of corridor shipment volume/throughput while preserving availability dates.

missing_for_scored_gold: actual throughput/utilization observations comparable with the sourced 5 bcm/year capacity
candidates.next_evidence_target: Add sourced actual throughput/utilization after commissioning and an independent pre-operation historical hypothesis record.
